notes.title: Fixes, Features, and Feedback!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Surprise! 
We bet you weren't expecting this were you? Well, your benevolent devs have returned to sprinkle TAGLINE with some much needed love and care. A big thanks to all of our friends on our discord server for sharing feedback and bringing issues to our attention. Now let's dive in and see what's on the agenda!

Let's begin with our fixes and polish:

Fixed an issue with unlocking Black Book achievements (Let us know if this persists).
Polished our Nav mesh, this should help with enemies getting stuck or confused!
Fixed visual glitches when restarting Terminal Quests (along with other UI polish).
Corrected whatever spelling mistakes we could find. 

And now for some fun stuff:

Added Haptic Feedback for controller players, along with respective settings.
Added Custom Cursors to the game, how neat!
Several new doodles and posters have been added -  Variety is the spice of life!
Added some set dressing and black lines to areas which were lacking. 

We've noticed incompatibilities with Apple operating systems and will be looking into this. Our gratitude is endless for everyone who has played and left a review for TAGLINE! Please leave a review on steam if you haven't already and keep the fan art, high scores, and feedback coming! 

[hr][/hr] Forever yours,
The NOTH Team

notes.title: The "QUICKPLAY" Update!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Eat. Sleep. Run. Repeat! 

Alex and Oscar here with some new content and bug fixes. Quickplay, a restart key, and the mysterious mouse clicking bug!

We are introducing QUICKPLAY in this update; a new option on the main menu which allows you to play any challenge you've encountered in the story. You'll be able to pre-select abilities and swap saves if you want to change your character upgrade status. Your global high scores will be tracked on this page.

Smaller updates include the much requested restart key. Hold down TAB (bindable) to instantly restart challenges and task terminals, no more fumbling through the pause screen! A fair amount of players reported mouse clicks not registering in game. This ended up being an issue tied to windows witchcraft. Please report if the issue persists!

We've got a small but mighty list of bullet points this update!

Added QUICKPLAY to the main menu, find challenges in any save file to unlock them here!
Added a RESTART button, holding this down will restart challenges and task terminals.
Fixed a bug where mouse clicks would not register for certain players.
Fixed a bug where certain bindings would be overridden when loading into zones.

You all have been incredibly helpful; please keep your eyes open for any further issues and let us know on our discord server. Feel free to post your times on our  Speedrun.com page and share your progress with us! Keep sending us your feedback and help us out with a positive review. Thank you all for the support!

[hr][/hr] See you at the finish line,
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Achievement Bugs are No More!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Happy New Year! 

Alex and Oscar here with a much-requested fix for TAGLINE! Some users were experiencing issues where achievements would not unlock. It took some work-arounds but we've been able to build in some failsafe's to ensure they'll be awarded.

Another big thank you to our dedicated players who have been reporting issues on our discord server; we always appreciate your bug reports!

Remember that leaving a positive review does wonders for us! Thanks for your support!

[hr][/hr] Happy New Year!
The NOTH Team

notes.title: DEV MEDAL Patches!

Dear players

If you come across any more bugs please continue to share them on our discord server we're keeping tabs on a number of issues and look forward to hearing more from you!

notes.title: DEV MEDALS! + New updates and fixes!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Hello all! 

Alex and Oscar here with some fixes and updates for TAGLINE! We've had a great influx of players who have been committed to speed running the challenges in the game. Given how difficult a challenge TAGLINE can be for some players, we did what any good devs would do: give you an even greater challenge to overcome!

Dev Medals were requested on our discord server and we're pleased to add our own semi-secretive, bone-crushing times and scores to the game! In addition to these we've also updated the game with some fixes.

Let's take a look at some bullet points shall we?

Added developer medals, these have no effect on game play outside of bragging rights!
Fixed a bug related to using the mouse on the trader menu.
Fixed an issue with the CRYB district screen during cutscenes. 
Fixed issues in both the HOTSPOT and ENDURANCE UI. 
Minor UI tweaks you won't even notice!

As always thanks for playing! We are aware of other issues on the horizon and will be getting to them in time. Thank you for your patience and for supporting us so far! Keep sending us your feedback and leave a positive review on steam it always helps!

[hr][/hr] Till next time,
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Post-Release Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
We hope you're enjoying TAGLINE! 

As with all new game releases it's customary to stumble across a few bugs, issues, and the stuff nightmares are made of! Luckily the NOTH team (Alex and Oscar) are here to save the day with our first post-release patch for TAGLINE. Our main focus was to eliminate rare softlocks and visual bugs. 

Thank you so much for the amazing feedback on our discord server; we're grateful for those of you who helped us spot some of these issues.

Here's a list of fresh bug fixes!

Players will no longer appear to have abilities equipped after death / challenges.
Fixed a bug that would let players softlock themselves after spawning into maps.
Added additional fail safes to some achievements.
Fixed a bug that would lock players inside the Black Book menu.
Fixed some issues with the blimp on MALL...
Fixed and added in the "Contact Sport" achievement.
Minor visual tweaks.

As always thanks for playing! It's been an awesome experience sharing this full game with you all, and it's great to see how much fun you're having! We are aware there may be other bugs and issues lurking around, so please keep sending us your feedback. Lastly, make sure to leave a positive review on steam this help us out tremendously!

[hr][/hr] Talk to you all soon!
The NOTH Team

notes.title: TAGLINE is available now!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Well, here we are! 

The NOTH team has some great news! We survived making TAGLINE! The game is officially available to all!

What a journey it's been, 4 years later and here we are! Numb, somewhat amazed, and a little humbled. If we had an ounce of energy left in our crumpled, neglected bodies; we'd give ourselves a pat on the back!A huge thank you to those who wishlisted the game, played the demo, and supported us! Particularly our friends in the discord server. From every last demo player to the those who shared ourwork on socials - you helped this game come true.

Please enjoy this little world we've crafted for you. Remember to share your scores, tell your friends, and tag us if you make any content about TAGLINE.Reviews help out tremendously, so post one on the page and let us know what you think of the game! We've got places to be, bugs to hunt, and naps to take but believe us; we'll be keeping in touch!

Enjoy!
Alex and Oscar
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Releasing Soon! / Important Updates for BETA Players.
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Hello all, 

  It's the NOTH team here again with some news you've likely heard already; release day is just around the corner! After a 4 year journey TAGLINE will be available to play on the 5th of October!

   To avoid some complications between Demo and Full game builds we are making tweaks which will erase save data for BETA players. Don't fret! - if you do wish to keep your BETA saves, you can keep them from getting erased by changing the following names in your game directory:

C:\Users\"Username"\AppData\Local\Tagline\Saved\SaveGames 
Change any file tilted "Save" 1/2/3etc. to "Slot"1/2/3.

   This should keep your saves from being wiped with the latest update. Beyond this there's little more to say except thank you for a fantastic year of support! As you can imagine, we've been working on updates, polish, and loads of content the past month; so we've gotto catch some shut-eye!

[hr][/hr] See you on release day!
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Demo Difficulty Balancing
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Hello again! 

It's the NOTH team (Alex and Oscar) with yet another patch to improve the TAGLINE demo! We've gotten a lot of feedback we wanted to address, mainly regarding difficulty. The demo was presenting  mid to late game challenges; so we took a look at balancing.

Note your saves will be deleted; but this is probably the last time the demo is affected.
At this point in development the demo will be receiving less love; most of our time moving forward is going to be focused on getting the game release ready!

Here's a list of some notable tweaks:

Adjusted spawn rate and score requirements for combat.
Changed properties of Waveform, Compressor, and Reverb to assist in combat:
Perform headshots with Waveform for a damage bonus. 
Reverb shots can penetrate through targets.
Compressor weakens enemy defenses. 
Balanced terminal challenge difficulty.
Minor visual bugs fixed; muzzle flashes, particles, ect.
Small bugs, balances, and inconsequential things!

As always thanks for playing! Make sure to wishlist the game and tell your friends; every new player fuels our fiery pilgrimage towards release!

[hr][/hr] Talk to you soon-
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Updates!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Next fest is here! 

Well, the Steam Next Fest is finally upon us; so of course we've got some big updates for demo players!
Highlights include a ton of polish to bring TAGLINE closer to release-ready quality.  The focus of this update is the addition of a momentum system and visual "gamefeel" additions (whatever that is). Let's recap!

New movement mechanics, no biggie! Build momentum by moving, and conserve speed after landing!
Some more Combat balancing, damage has been tweaked around to make you feel cooler.
Strafing now causes the player to lean, there’s a setting to disable it if it’s not your style.
Screen shake and hand shake. Just tons of feedback to help the game feel more weighted!
Shiny new particles! Hit confirms - explosion decals, and “bullet holes”. 
Some new destructible objects, posters, and art assets I’ve honestly lost track of.
Most importantly: pigeons. With AI so advanced it makes chat bots look like preschoolers. 
Mundane, behind the scenes content that only belongs on our discord server.

A reminder that wishlisting the game really helps us 2 lonesome devs get noticed by the Steam algorithm! We are absolutely thrilled over the latest boost in interest so please, keep sharing the game around, keep streaming, and keep letting us know your thoughts! A huge thanks as always to those who have been supporting us, and a warm welcome to any new players!

[hr][/hr] Enjoy, and thank you for playing!
The NOTH Team

notes.title: TAGLINE DEMO UPDATES!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Our biggest demo update yet!

We want to say thank you for playing the TAGLINE demo and spreading the word! Your radiant, mildly corrosive energy is keeping development alive! The feedback really helped us focus on what was important to include in this push. Colorblind modes, key bindings, movement tweaks... There's months of work to cover here - so let's get to it!

Some of the biggest changes include:

A tutorial area with it's own collectables and cut scenes!
A new job terminal and basketball challenge have been added to the level!
Working mini-map and pause screen, with collectable and challenge tracker.
Way more stuff do, almost twice the amount of vinyls to grab!
A graffiti collection mission - good luck finding all the tags!
Tweaked player movement and jumping. Scary for us, more fun for you!
Added a proper options menu with settings and keybindings finally!
You have access to save files, a main menu, and more quality of life goodness.
Typos, tweaks, level secrets, and a ton of squashed bugs!

[hr][/hr] As we push forward this year there's going to be some scary announcements and big developments, we are getting closer and closer to the final look and scope of TAGLINE! So stay tuned, wishlist us if you enjoyed the demo and keep providing the feedback! Keep us posted on your thoughts and brag about your highest scores on our Discord server!

[hr][/hr] Thank you for your overwhelming support 
The NOTH Team (Alex and Oscar)

notes.title: New Demo Tweaks!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
New gameplay tweaks!🌃

We've got bug fixes and updates today with a focus on improving Waveform / Compressor abilities outside of combat!

Here's the lowdown:
Waveform (pink) platforms stick to the ground at an angle, creating slanted surfaces.😉
Compressor (red) has new effects on the player while in the air...
You can no longer interact with NPC's / terminals while standing on a waveform disk.
Further beautified the map, adding some new posters and decals!
There is a small delay between tag grabbing and attacking to fix animation grossness.
Bug squashes ranging from animation issues to the player respawn. 
Tweaks so tiny they can only be seen on our discord server. 

[hr][/hr]We eat feedback for breakfast and we're hungry! Your thoughts and opinions are a driving force for development, so please let us know how we can improve, manage and fine tune the game! Leave your comments on steam or find us on our ever growing Discord server!
[hr][/hr] Catch you around,
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Demo Updates!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
Our demo has a fresh coat of paint!🌃

It’s been 10 days since the demo for TAGLINE dropped and we’ve received a lot of great feedback from players. Being the responsible developers that we are; we've pushed an update to address issues and make the demo more enjoyable for all! The biggest change in this update is that we’ve upgraded to unreal engine 4.27!

The highlights of this update include:

New players will be greeted by an NPC to help introduce objectives. 
Added a terminal challenge, and an additional record to collect (12 in total)!
Our 2D assets have had their artifacts cleaned up, they’re gorgeous now.
Improved methods for NPC interaction, basketball pickups, and tag grabbing.
Stability and compatibility with Windows 11 has been improved.
Typos, tweaks, and bugs too boring to list here.
[hr][/hr]Note that this update will wipe your save file and high scores.This is a tough consequence of these changes but look on the bright side; you’ve got some new scores to beat. Remember to let us know your thoughts on the changes, and come share your best scores with us on our Discord server!
[hr][/hr] Thanks for playing, your pals
The NOTH Team
